text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff! HUFF, PUFF!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yay! I won! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All riiiiight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea Matikanetannhauser was so

amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
People have been talking about her
since the
Japanese Derby! She's really
optimistic and you
can't help but like
her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She's not overwhelmingly talented or
anything,
but she's a good runner who
works hard and never
gives up.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She works hard and never gives up...
You're right
about that.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Um, e-excuse me! Would you mind
sharing those
thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Especially in regards to
Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sure thing! Gotta spread the good
word
about Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the know has their eye on
her. She's a
racer's racer. Or something
like that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Anyhoo, it's about time I get back to
campus for
some running! I need to
catch up too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking through the runners' tunnel
to pick up
Matikanetannhauser when I
hear some faint
voices.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I just want to say thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I really, truly gave it my all today! I
competed as
the best version of myself!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And I think—No, I know it's thanks to
you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So... thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I feel the same.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm several times better than I was
previously. But
that's only because I
needed to be if I wished to
stay ahead
of you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to running with you
senior
year too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Me too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After exchanging compliments, the two
of them
return to the waiting room in a
good mood.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There it is. Classic year is over.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Can you believe I won?! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's enough celebrating for now.
I actually
have a little suggestion...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking about what I wanna
do after
the Classic Triple Crown tour is
finished.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember what the director said
to me at
summer camp?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Like how it's not my race record that's
interesting,
and that being ordinary is
part of my charm or
something!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy when she said that but,
honestly,
there's something I just can't
wrap my head
around.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
After all, the people who motivate
others are
usually really cool and strong
and... all
sparkly-like.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I want to live up to the expectations she
has for
me, but the more I think about,
the more
confused I get.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, for now, I'm just gonna go where my
heart
tells me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And right now, the spring Tenno Sho is
what gets
my heart thumping most!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I know it won't be easy! It's a
3,200-meter
long-distance G1 race that
decides the best
stayer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure coming up with a strategy will
be tough,
and I probably don't have
enough stamina yet.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But still, wouldn't it be awesome to win a
big race
like that in the spring?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may not be aware of it herself, but
she's just
as optimistic as always.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And I know there's no preliminary for it
or
anything, but I'd like to run another
long-distance
race before then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Like the 3,400-meter Diamond Stakes
or
something!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's not really any reason for me to
say no. If
she wants to do it, I want to
help.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've got it next time. I've just gotta work
hard!
Just gotta grind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next race is a long-distance
G3
race—the Diamond Stakes!
